item.title: Miguel Rojas Already Begins New Dodgers Role After Retirement
item.description: Los Angeles Dodgers outfielder Miguel Rojas, recently retired , is already starting work with the team in his new role within the organization. Rojas working Dodgers facility In an Instagram story on Monday, October 26th, Rojas posted a photo of the Dodgers’ developmental facility in Arizona and captioned it, “Work” with an eyeball emoji. Rojas’ exact title remains unclear, but he announced his emotional retirement and confirmed he will step away from the baseball field, while also alluding to a role within the coaching staff. Jun 4, 2026; Phoenix, Arizona, USA; Los Angeles Dodgers infielder Miguel Rojas (72) smiles in the dugout before the game against the Arizona Diamondbacks at Chase Field. Mandatory Credit: Anna Carrington-Imagn Images With his one-year deal for the 2026 season, Rojas agreed to take a player development role with the Dodgers. “I told them that I’m gonna be loyal. I wanna stay here,” Rojas said. “I wanna wear this uniform or this logo in a different capacity, and continue to make the organization better.” Rojas’ main goal as a coach This new role is no surprise to him, since he has long been laying the groundwork to eventually become an MLB coach. Over the last two years, Rojas has worked to coach his teammates in whatever capacity he can. “I understand what part of my career I’m in right now — I might be playing for a few more years and then I’m going to have to do something after baseball,” Rojas said back in 2024. “I’m embracing this opportunity to actually start coaching a little bit with my teammates. That way, I can prepare myself for what’s coming next.” View this post on Instagram A post shared by Dodgers Nation (@dodgersnation) Rojas has laid out his goal of becoming a manager, and this new role with the Dodgers, whatever it is, will set him up to climb the coaching ranks. As a player-coach, he has helped Mookie Betts develop his infield game while also helping other players defensively. Given how elite he has been defensively throughout his career, it is no surprise to see him help players in that role. Oct 12, 2024; Los Angeles, CA, USA; Los Angeles Dodgers manager Dave Roberts (right) speaks to shortstop Miguel Rojas (left) during the NLCS workouts at Dodgers Stadium. Mandatory Credit: Kiyoshi Mio-Imagn Images Rojas might be better suited as a cultural presence and locker-room leader than as an outright mechanical coach, though a strong leader is the kind of person who can become a manager one day. On line-up decisions and bullpen management, Rojas has much to learn, but he has clearly followed the lead of his former manager, Dave Roberts.

item.description: The Ballon d’Or ceremony in London has been delayed by 30 minutes due to traffic issues in the area. item.description: Kansas City Current No Shield was clinched and no final playoff spot was claimed, as the NWSL season will all come down to Decision Day to determine who's occupying all eight spots in the post-season. It all comes down to Decision Day to determine the National Women's Soccer League (NWSL) Shield and final playoff positions. Decision Day is on Sunday, November 1 and all 16 NWSL clubs will be competing. After one of the final weekends of NWSL action, there were several spots up for grabs in the playoff race. Angel City and Kansas City put on a show just when it mattered most, with the LA-based club defeating Bay FC, 2-0, to extend their unbeaten run to nine games. The Current also are peaking at just the right time, and defeated the Washington Spirit, 2-1, on their home turf to spring to fourth place in the league standings, their highest spot since the first week of NWSL action. Gotham FC were positioned to claim the Shield, but due to results elsewhere across the league, they will have to wait until Decision Day, where either a win or draw against the Utah Royals will hand them the Shield. Utah on the other hand, sealed their first-ever post-season berth after a 0-0 draw against Seattle Reign FC. San Diego Wave could have made things harder for Gotham in the Shield race, but played to a 2-2 draw against the Boston Legacy. While they could still claim the Shield, it would need a Gotham loss and a better goal difference. The craziest game had to be Denver Summit's 6-1 stomping over Racing Louisville, led by a brace from Natasha Flint. Denver could still very well see their way into the playoffs, and have a league-leading 53 goals in their inaugural season. item.title: Browns make Dillon Gabriel roster move after Week 7 comeback win over Titans
item.description: Browns make Dillon Gabriel roster move after Week 7 comeback win over Titans originally appeared on The Sporting News . Add The Sporting News as a Preferred Source by clicking here . The Cleveland Browns are a surprising 5-2 on the regular season following another comeback win, this time over the Tennessee Titans in Week 7. Tied atop the AFC North, the Browns are now set to face off against the 5-2 Pittsburgh Steelers in Week 8 for a chance to enter the bye in Week 9 with sole possession of first place in the division. One day after their Week 7 win, however, the Browns announced an interesting roster move with Dillon Gabriel. According to the Browns, Gabriel has been activated off injured reserve, officially making it so that four quarterbacks are on the 53-man roster. Browns activated Dillon Gabriel from IR, have 4 QBs on 53-man roster "We've activated QB Dillon Gabriel from injured reserve and waived TE Carsen Ryan," The Browns announced Monday afternoon. This roster move from the Browns shouldn't come as a surprise, as Gabriel was set to come back to the team's NFL roster after being placed on Injured Reserve before the season began. Now, Gabriel is officially back and can play if he is ever needed. But his activation presents an interesting problem for the Browns: they have four QBs on the roster. Deshaun Watson is the starter and doesn't appear close to losing that job, and Shedeur Sanders has served as the backup to begin the season. Taylen Green is last on the depth chart and is likely fourth with Gabriel's activation. MORE : NFL insider reveals Browns might not be done with Deshaun Watson after 2026 Keeping four quarterbacks is possible, but with the NFL trade deadline just around two weeks away, it would hardly be a surprise to see Gabriel or Sanders get traded. Watson and Green aren't going anywhere, so Gabriel or Sanders could be on the move. For Todd Monken and the Browns, a fourth QB on the roster doesn't really help them out much this season. So, as the trade deadline nears, now with four QBs on the roster after this Monday afternoon roster move, Browns fans should expect to hear Sanders and Gabriel pop up in trade speculation until the November trade deadline passes. item.title: Rematch! Alex Volkanovski eyes Ilia Topuria do-over if Justin Gaethje retires from UFC
item.description: ABU DHABI, UNITED ARAB EMIRATES - OCTOBER 26: (R-L) Ilia Topuria of Spain has words with former champion Alexander Volkanovski after his victory against Max Holloway in the UFC featherweight championship fight during the UFC 308 event at Etihad Arena on October 26, 2024 in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates. (Photo by Chris Unger/Zuffa LLC) Alexander Volkanovski is nearing the end of his hall of fame MMA career and wants to retire from UFC in the most spectacular way possible. That’s why “The Great” has set his sights on a championship super fight against current 155-pound kingpin Justin Gaethje for early to mid 2027. But if “The Highlight” calls it quits , it might be the perfect opportunity for Volkanovski to avenge his 2024 loss to Ilia Topuria . “If it was going to be for a lightweight title, that’d be great, because I get that win back as well,” Volkanovski told Brendan Bradford . “Gaethje took that zero, so I can’t say that I get the chance to take that zero from him, but to get that win back would be great. Nothing against him obviously, he’s a great fighter, great dude, we get along well.” “But at the same time, I’m a competitor, and I would love to test myself against him,” Volkanovski continued. “How that would work probably doesn’t make sense. If Gaethje does retire, maybe I can find someone. Win, lose, or draw I retire, so I’m not holding the division up. That’ll be something very exciting. And I think everyone should be on board on that.” Topuria lost the lightweight title (and his undefeated record) to Gaethje at UFC White House last June . Volkanovski (29-4) is coming off a technical knockout victory over Movsar Evloev in the main event of UFC 333 last weekend in Abu Dhabi, his third straight win since falling to Topuria. UFC CEO Dana White is on board with whatever the Aussie wants to do next , it’s just a matter of finding a willing opponent.

item.title: Patriots release veteran punter Bryce Baringer
item.description: The Patriots are moving on from their longtime punter. According to the NFL Network, the Patriots are releasing veteran Bryce Baringer . The team’s punter from the last three seasons, Baringer was in line to start this season in the same role before suffering an injury this preseason. Baringer had been on the Patriots injured reserve. That led to the team signing veteran punter Mitch Wishnowsky, who now officially takes over the team’s full-time punter position. “I certainly appreciate what Bryce has been able to do for us. Those are tough decisions,” Mike Vrabel said. “I don’t think those are things that you necessarily take lightly, but once you kind of get the specialists and the snap or the hold and all the stuff that they do, and we just felt like this was best for us and best for Bryce and give him an opportunity to kind of go punt and see if somebody needs a punter and if we would need him back and he was there that we would want to have him back. “It’s just you kind of make a decision with a specialist, and as long as it’s going well, which I think it is and everybody else does, you kind of just stick with it.” BETTING: For Sunday’s meeting between the Pats and the Dolphins, the over/under is set at 44.5 points on Polymarket . For a closer look, visit our guide to the best Massachusetts sportsbooks to shop for odds. Baringer was a sixth-round pick by the Patriots in 2023. He was a solid, stable punter over the previous three seasons, replacing Jake Bailey. He started his career with a punt of at least 50 yards in each of his first 26 games. It was the longest active streak in the NFL. Baringer suffered a lower-body injury in the Patriots’ second preseason game against the Philadelphia Eagles. The team signed veteran punter Matt Haack for their preseason finale. The Patriots released Haack on cut-down day and signed Wishnowsky to the practice squad. The Patriots eventually signed Wishnowsky to their active roster in September. In seven games, he’s averaged 47.1 yards per punt and has punted 45.5% of his punts inside the 20-yard line. “I think he gets it off quickly. I think the plus 50s have improved,” Vrabel said of Wishnowsky. “Got different punts and different kicks that he uses and I think he’s been pretty consistent. item.description: Barcelona making it hard for Arsenal to sign Premier League sensation Eli Junior Kroupi has been one of the top strikers in the Premier League and was the best-scoring teenager in the competition last season. The Frenchman’s talent is not in question, and his goal-scoring record speaks for itself, but the competition for his signature is fierce. Barca signed Gabriel Jesus in the summer , but he is not who they truly wanted, and Kroupi could bench him in Catalonia. The striker’s injury is a concern, but his potential is enormous, and the big clubs are circling. Arsenal’s need for a striker is clear, and Kroupi fits the profile. The fans will be hoping the club can get the deal done. The coming weeks will show whether Arsenal can beat Barcelona to his signature, as the race heats up. item.title: Manuel Neuer set to resume training for Bayern Munich, still a doubt for FC Magdeburg
item.description: (Photo by Stuart Franklin - UEFA/UEFA via Getty Images) | UEFA via Getty Images Manuel Neuer has missed the past two Bundesliga matches for Bayern Munich, despite playing in the 2-2 Champions League draw with Arsenal last week. The veteran goalkeeper has been dealing with tendon irritation and fluid accumulation in his foot, which caused him to miss the 3-1 win at SC Freiburg and the 6-1 victory over RB Leipzig. Jonas Urbig took his spot in goal for those two occasions, having also started the 3-3 draw at Viking FK in the Champions League two weeks ago. As for Neuer’s current status, Bayern board member for sport Max Eberl—who is taking on additional media duties while Vincent Kompany rests and recovers from last week’s collapse—provided an update on the goalkeeper. Eberl himself missed the trip to the London Palladium for the Ballon d’Or ceremony due to a cold. Eberl stated that Neuer “should resume training at some point this week,” though he remains a doubt for the midweek, second-round DFB-Pokal clash against FC Magdeburg, as per Tz (via @iMiaSanMia ). A decision on whether Neuer will play in the Pokal match is expected shortly before kickoff. Urbig would deputize if Neuer is not deemed fit enough to feature. The club ideally wants to avoid taking unnecessary risks with Neuer ahead of this weekend’s match against Borussia Dortmund, as rushing him back too quickly has proven costly in the past. It makes sense to give Urbig the Pokal match against Magdeburg, as he also started the first-round win over VfL Osnabrück. The club had already planned for this season to be transitional, with Neuer continuing to mentor Urbig. Kompany has made it clear that Urbig will receive more matches this season, making a midweek appearance logical. This would allow Neuer to continue regaining full fitness before returning to the goal for the Dortmund match—unless the club opts to give Neuer minutes for the sake of continuity ahead of Der Klassiker . item.title: Two Camaros Pitted for Fuel Late at Surfers Paradise, and Anton De Pasquale Took the Last Finals Seat
item.description: Photo: Kytabu, Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 4.0) Ten drivers walked into Sunday’s Gold Coast 500 finale still chasing a Finals seat. Seven walked out. The last place was settled by a stretch of laps in which the quickest car had no say at all, because two Chevrolet Camaros that were not supposed to be in the pits drove into them. Jarrod Hughes (Erebus) and Cooper Murray (PremiAir) both dropped out of the top ten for late fuel stops. Those stops handed Anton De Pasquale the two positions he needed, and his 14th-place finish was enough to put him into the Semi Final field at Sandown. Ryan Wood, who had been in the cut on the strength of a Walkinshaw TWG team swap with Chaz Mostert that the regulations allow, found the swap erased by the shuffle behind him. Two explanations, one convenient outcome The teams’ own accounts are plain enough. Erebus principal Brad Tremain described a fuel calculation error that would have left Hughes four laps short of the flag. PremiAir’s Roland Dane said Murray was underfuelled. General Motors’ Supercars boss Simon McNamara denied that the manufacturer had any hand in the stops. Take them at face value and you get two unrelated arithmetic failures landing in the same late window of a 250km sprint. That is possible. It is also exactly the kind of coincidence that draws attention when a single position decides who gets a title shot and who goes home. The fuel numbers are the evidence that matters, and they belong to the teams and the series, not to us. What can be said is why the suspicion exists: in a Finals format, one place on one lap is worth a season. The line Supercars has to police The Walkinshaw swap shows where the sporting line sits. A team telling its own cars to change places is within the rules, and Wood’s engineer was updating him on the cut-line as the race ran. A manufacturer coordinating cars across several teams would be a different matter entirely. Nobody has produced evidence of that here, and McNamara’s denial stands on the record, but expect the question to follow the Chevrolet teams into their debriefs. Wood’s own reaction was measured. He said he was surprised that both Camaros had to fuel at the end, noted that the gap he needed closed after their stops, and said the team would look into it. Hughes had already made contact with him once, hitting his door at the Turn 4 hairpin as the two fought over track position. Brodie Kostecki in the Shell V-Power Racing Team Mustang that won this year’s Bathurst 1000, one of the cars the Finals field will have to beat. Image: Shell V-Power Racing Team What it costs Wood, and what Mostert gains Wood’s Finals run ends at this stage for the second year in a row. He drops to ninth in the points and, under a 2026 rule change, loses his Finals bonuses. item.title: Cowboys key matchup: Brian Schottenheimer vs Vic Fangio
item.description: Photo by Michael Reaves/Getty Images For the first time this season, we will be focusing more on the coaches on the sideline than the players on the field. With the Philadelphia Eagles extremely banged up on offense, and Brian Schottenheimer scooting closer-and-closer to the hot seat, this may be the biggest game of Schottenheimer’s coaching career. The Cowboys head into this week seven matchup fully healthy on offense with the Eagles near full health on defense, minus Nolan Smith out due to a concussion. We have yet to really see it so far this season, but the Cowboys need Schottenheimer to be the “elite play caller” he referred to himself as late last week. Unlike the last two weeks, the Cowboys should expect a pretty clear picture of Vic Fangio’s plan. Like we have learned with Christian Parker, Fangio is not a heavy blitzer and relies on his coverage scheme to keep opposing offenses under control. While we should expect Fangio to ramp up his pressure a bit more due to the Cowboys struggles to handle it the last few weeks, Dak Prescott should not be dealing with as many exotic blitz looks pre-and-post snap like he did against Tampa Bay and Green Bay. The Philadelphia Eagles defense currently looks like a shell of itself from recent years. Through six weeks, the Eagles defense ranks 25th in EPA/play, 23rd in drop back EPA/play, and 31st in rush EPA/play. Given the struggles of the Cowboys running game this season, this is a matchup they can get back on track with. Jalen Carter has turned it on over the last few weeks, after playing with an injured wrist early in the season. Zack Baun is still one of the better linebackers in the NFL, but the depth behind him can be targeted in the running game. With Nolan Smith out tonight, expect the Cowboys to run it early towards AJ Epenesa and/or Arnold Ebikete. With the names like Quinyon Mitchell, Cooper DeJean, Riq Woolen, and Andrew Mukuba in the secondary, you would think the running game would be the only path to success for the Cowboys offense, but their secondary outside of Mitchell has struggled this year in coverage. Similar to Javonte Williams, this is a solid matchup for the Cowboys wide receivers to get back on track both as pass catchers and run blockers. At the end of the day, this all comes down to Schottenheimer’s ability to prove himself as a play-caller and game-planner. We have not seen much consistency from the Cowboys offensive coaching staff so far this season, but it’s a great week, in a must-win game, to get back on track.

item.title: FIFA launches investigation after racism allegation as England walk out of U15 World Cup game
item.description: England's Under-15 FIFA World Cup game against the Republic of Ireland was abandoned after an alleged racist incident, after which the Three Lions walked off -Credit:Reach Publishing Services Limited FIFA are investigating an allegation of racist abuse by a Republic of Ireland player that resulted in the abandonment of England's Under-15 World Cup match. The incident occurred during Monday's fixture in Azerbaijan, when an England player was observed approaching the touchline to alert his coaching staff of the alleged abuse, before the complaint was brought to the official's attention. England's coaching staff subsequently instructed their players to exit the pitch, with the Republic of Ireland holding a 4-1 advantage entering the final minute of the game. FIFA have since confirmed they are examining the incident and collecting reports to determine the circumstances surrounding the allegation. "Fifa is aware of an incident at the U-15 World Cup and Festival match between England and the Republic of Ireland," a spokesperson said, via The Mirror . "The match was abandoned by the referee following England's refusal to continue. England head coach Matt Thorpe was observed summoning the referee over before directing his players to leave the field. Thorpe was reportedly informed by the official that he 'could not hear.' One of Thorpe's assistant coaches was then heard informing the official, 'We are reporting racism,' before stating, 'We do not want to play.' It was later reported that a player was 'upset.' A tense confrontation reportedly occurred between the two coaching staffs as both teams attempted to safeguard their players. Neither the FA nor the FAI have issued a statement concerning the incident at this time.

item.title: Patriots takeaways: Injury updates on offensive linemen Alijah Vera-Tucker and Ben Brown
item.description: FOXBOROUGH – The Patriots got bad news last week when Alijah Vera-Tucker suffered a hamstring injury. After the starting left guard was ruled out of the team’s matchup in Chicago, the veteran was then placed on injured reserve. This marked the fourth time in Vera-Tucker’s six-year NFL career that he’s landed on IR. The 27-year-old missed all of last season with the New York Jets due to a triceps injury. The recent news left his Patriots teammates feeling for their teammate, but it also sounds as if Vera-Tucker didn’t suffer a season-ending injury. Right tackle Morgan Moses said Vera-Tucker was in good spirits because he found out he’ll be able to return at some point this season. “I’ve known him since his rookie year, so I know the type of work he’s put in. I know who he is as a player and as a person, and so you feel for a guy,” Morgan Moses said. “But he’s encouraged, you know, he’s encouraged that he has some possibility to be able to play down the road.” The 14th overall pick in the 2021 draft, Vera-Tucker came to the NFL as a very talented offensive line prospect. However, health has been his biggest issue. The guard played in 43 out of a possible 85 regular season games with the Jets from 2021 to 2025. In 2022, Vera-Tucker played in seven games before suffering a season-ending triceps injury. The next season, he played in six games due to suffering a season-ending Achilles tear. After missing all of last season, Vera-Tucker worked hard to get healthy and the Patriots signed him to an incentive-laden contract. This season, the guard receives $250,000 for each game active. “I can’t speak for him. I don’t understand what he is going through himself, but I can only imagine knowing what he’s been through in past seasons,” center Jared Wilson said. “That’s my dog. I feel for him, man. It’s just horrible.” At the moment, the Patriots have both starting guards, Vera-Tucker and Mike Onwenu, and top backup Greg Van Roten on injured reserve. The team had Walter Rouse (left guard) and Matt Pryor (right guard) start last Thursday against the Chicago Bears. Washington Commanders head coach Dan Quinn may have bought himself more time, but he still needs wins to secure his future with the franchise. After Washington’s comeback attempt against the San Francisco 49ers, NFL insider Ian Rapoport believes Quinn has earned a reprieve as the team looks to turn its season around. “Another name to watch is Dan Quinn of the Washington Commanders, who went into the San Francisco 49ers game with some heat; I think that is fair to say. The effort may have helped Quinn’s standing with the organization , but moral victories will only go so far.
